public_rationale: The original concierge service remained a restricted experiment and was canceled without its promised expansion. That supports the ordinary reading of never taking off. Facebook reported research progress, and related automated features survived, so this finding does not mean that all work on M was fruitless.
limitations: Broad uptake is an ordinary-language reading, not a numerical threshold supplied by Marcus.
The decisive availability record is contemporary reporting containing Facebook's statement.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Facebook's Project M agent never really took off.

statement.excerpt: Alas, it never really took off.

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that the original concierge service never achieved broad public availability or uptake.
The claim concerns the original assistant, not every later feature using the M name.
The target period covers the stated launch year through the stated cancellation month. No numerical adoption threshold is added.
criteria.support_condition: Records show that the original assistant remained a limited trial until cancellation, without broad public availability or uptake.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Records show that the original assistant achieved broad public availability or substantial adoption beyond its limited trial before cancellation.
